title: Cookie Management
definition: The practice of managing and utilizing cookies to store user data on their devices.

difficulty_levels.beginner: Cookies are small data files that websites store on your device. They help remember your preferences and activity, making your online experience more personalized and convenient.
difficulty_levels.intermediate: Cookies enable the browsing session to be maintained across different pages, help in personalizing content, and support various website functionalities. However, they can also raise privacy concerns if not properly managed.
difficulty_levels.expert: Cookies are a crucial aspect of web development and digital privacy. They enable statefulness in stateless HTTP protocols, but their unregulated usage can lead to data leakage and privacy violations. Additionally, the widespread use of cookies for tracking and advertising contributes to data monopolies and compromises user autonomy.

extra_fields.insight: The displayed cookie names and their shared expiration date of January 1, 1970, suggests an unconventional cookie management strategy.
